description: Post a message as the bot. To answer a slack.event, pass its channel_id as channel and its thread_ts, or its message_ts to open a thread under it. Needs text, blocks or both; long text is posted as several messages. Returns the posted messages and clears the thread's assistant status.

channel.description: Conversation id from a slack.event, or a member id for a direct message. Omit it only for the configured default channel or the single allowed member.

thread_ts.description: Thread to answer in: the event's thread_ts, or its message_ts to start a thread under that message.

text.description: Message text in Markdown, converted to Slack formatting.

fallback_text.description: Notification text when only blocks are given.

mrkdwn.description: Apply Slack formatting to text; true by default.

reply_broadcast.description: Also show a thread reply in the channel.

team_id.description: Workspace: team_id from the slack.event. Needed only when this interface serves several workspaces.
